logistics.format: Web-based proctored, open-book reference (ProctorU or PearsonVUE)

recommended_certs.rationale: GCFE で Windows ホスト系フォレンジックの基礎を固めてから、モバイル特化の GASF へ進むと法執行 / DFIR としての守備範囲が広がる。

plus.note: スマートフォンフォレンジック特化の認証は少なく、法執行・eDiscovery 分野で需要がある。

minus.note: Cellebrite/Magnet 等の商用ツール教育と紐づきがちで、ベンダー横断性に注意。

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced specialty: 3. The existing unordered-specialty rule applies when at least one reviewer identifies a specialty track. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Smartphone forensic depth and accreditation support a specialized investigative role, while commercial-tool dependence and the narrow mobile evidence focus make general seniority a poor fit.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Accreditation and smartphone-forensic depth make GASF a credible focused DFIR specialization. Its tool-specific risk and narrow mobile scope are better expressed as specialty than as a general seniority step.

alex-novak.rationale: The record describes smartphone forensics as a distinct investigative niche, with a three-year profile and accreditation. Its potential dependence on commercial tooling makes specialty more accurate than a general DFIR promotion.
